title: Cash Pickup Send Amounts, Corridor Caps and Recipient Frequency by Tier
content:
Every Cash Pickup tier sets a smallest and a largest principal in US dollars for each transfer, a per-corridor ceiling on what its payout network can pay in one pickup, and a largest number of Cash Pickup transfers to one recipient in a rolling 24 hours.

## Principal range and recipient frequency

| Cash Pickup tier | Smallest principal (USD) | Largest principal (USD) | Most Cash Pickup transfers to one recipient in a rolling 24 hours |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cash Pickup Economy | 10.00 | 2999.00 | 3 |
| Cash Pickup Express | 10.00 | 2999.00 | 5 |
| Cash Pickup Express Plus | 50.00 | 5000.00 | 5 |
| Cash Pickup Bank Branch | 10.00 | 7500.00 | 3 |
| Cash Pickup Cardless ATM | 10.00 | 500.00 | 2 |
| Cash Pickup Large Amount | 3000.00 | 15000.00 | 1 |

The largest principal is the tier's own figure. It applies before the per-transfer limit of the sender's account level is considered.

## Per-corridor payout caps (USD principal in one pickup)

| Corridor | Economy | Express | Express Plus | Bank Branch | Cardless ATM | Large Amount |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| MX-MXN | 2999.00 | 2999.00 | 5000.00 | 7500.00 | 450.00 | 15000.00 |
| GT-GTQ | 2500.00 | 2500.00 | 4000.00 | 5000.00 | not served | 10000.00 |
| SV-USD | 3000.00 | 3000.00 | 5000.00 | 7500.00 | not served | not served |
| HN-HNL | 2500.00 | 2500.00 | 4000.00 | 5000.00 | not served | not served |
| DO-DOP | 3000.00 | 3000.00 | 5000.00 | 6000.00 | not served | 12000.00 |
| CO-COP | 2000.00 | 2000.00 | 3500.00 | 5000.00 | 400.00 | 10000.00 |
| PH-PHP | 2600.00 | 2600.00 | 4000.00 | 5000.00 | 350.00 | 10000.00 |
| VN-VND | 2500.00 | 2500.00 | 4000.00 | 5000.00 | not served | 10000.00 |
| BD-BDT | 2000.00 | 2000.00 | 3000.00 | 4000.00 | not served | not served |
| NG-NGN | 1000.00 | 1000.00 | 1500.00 | 2000.00 | not served | not served |
| GH-GHS | 1500.00 | 1500.00 | 2500.00 | 3000.00 | not served | not served |

Column headings are the tier names without the "Cash Pickup" prefix. "Not served" marks a corridor outside that tier's network.

## Reading the caps

- A corridor cap is the most the payout network pays in one pickup in that corridor, measured as US-dollar principal.
- The cap and the tier's largest principal are separate figures. Some caps sit below the tier's largest principal (Cash Pickup Economy to NG-NGN: cap 1000.00, tier maximum 2999.00). Some sit above it (Cash Pickup Economy to SV-USD: cap 3000.00, tier maximum 2999.00).
